learning_outcomes.text: Improve and develop students' existing communication skills and master the basic rules of communication and negotiation in work practice.
Basic orientation of the students in the wide range of literature and electronic resources in this area.

syllabus_topics: Human communication (intrapersonal, interpersonal, group, inter-group, public speaking)
Communication as part of the qualification of every worker for an executive or leadership position.
Listening, relational ties as a component of communication
Verbal communication (rhetoric), its types, means and tools, communication manipulation and counter-manipulation
Non-verbal communication, its types, means and tools, the third layer of communication
Negotiation incl. conflict resolution and negotiation with problem persons
How not to be deceived in communication
Development of communication in the 21st century

assessment_methods.method: Submission of two written reports (analysis of a selected speech, development of communication in the 21st century)
